item.title: TuringQ Planning to IPO and In Race to Become China’s First Public Quantum Firm
item.summary: Shanghai-based photonic quantum firm TuringQ has officially initiated pre-IPO tutoring with the Shanghai branch of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, positioning itself as a leading contender in the race to become China’s first publicly listed quantum computing company.
